expectations.evidence: Defines --color-primary, --color-surface etc. with [data-theme] selectors; all components use var(--color-*)
No ::ng-deep anywhere in code or text
ThemeService with toggle() and effect() setting data-theme on documentElement; ThemeToggleComponent provides the UI toggle
No ViewEncapsulation.None/ShadowDom used; explains why emulated encapsulation works with CSS custom properties
CardComponent uses var(--color-surface), var(--color-outline), var(--color-on-surface); ButtonComponent uses var(--color-primary), var(--color-secondary)
